name: Special Admit Program
what_you_do: Take Mt. SAC college classes on campus or online, on top of your regular high school schedule. You earn college credit while you are still in high school.
who_can_apply: California K to 12 students who are enrolled in school now. You need written permission from your high school. Students below grade 9 may need extra steps.
duration: By term: summer, fall, winter or spring
deadline_text: As of Nov 3, 2026, Winter and Spring 2027 packets are being accepted. Winter 2027: packets due by Dec 9, classes start Jan 4, 2027. Spring 2027: packets due by Feb 8, classes start Feb 22, 2027. The packet dates show no year.
how_to_apply: Apply to Mt. SAC for each term. Do the Assessment Questionnaire once. Finish a Special Admit Packet each term with three signatures, including your parent and your school. Then register on your date. Call (909) 274-6030.
notes: Seats are first come, first served, and some classes are not open to you. Mt. SAC also runs Dual Enrollment at partner high schools; ask your school. The resources section lists Spring registration as Nov 12, 2027, which looks like a typo, so check your date in the student portal.
